text:
sara-marketing: Kick-off — I'm drafting the launch post + webinar invite + landing copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Need benchmark bullets and inbound lead routing plan. ETA for copy v1 EOD Wed. Thoughts?

javier-growth: Love it. For launch posts let's do 3 variants: technical benchmark, cost story, reliability narrative. Short stat lines work best. Can we get a 1-liner per mode?

emily-prod: I can pull the perf numbers tomorrow: p99 latency (hosted vs dedicated), tokens/sec, cost per 1k tokens at our default batch. Will also add a note about private fallback behavior.

mike-ux: We need hero tone split: "Ship LLM features without inference ops" (developer first) vs "Predictable throughput for mission-critical" (enterprise). We'll test both.

linda-content: Drafting micro-copy now. Proposed hero options:
- Hosted: "Start serving LLMs in minutes — simple API, streaming, scale."
- Dedicated: "Predictable throughput, isolated capacity for production."
- Private: "On-prem or VPC — keep data and keys under your control."

sara-marketing: Nice. Let's A/B test "Start serving" vs "Ship LLM features" in hero. Also want a 2-line subhead under each with benefit + CTA.

rachel-sales: Inbound routing idea: webinar signups -> hidden form field `use_case` -> route hot leads (SaaS & Platform) to AE queue; others to nurture. Add checkbox for "privacy/regulation" to flag Private interest.

tom-ops: We can do that. Recommend UTM + hidden fields: `utm_source`, `utm_medium`, `product_mode`. Snippet: 
```html
<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"product_mode\" value=\"hosted\">
```

javier-growth: Also add a mini benchmark card on the landing: Median latency | Tokens/sec | Cost/unit. We can repurpose visuals from last infra report. Short bullets are good for social.

chris-analytics: I'll send an event schema: `event=webinar_signup` + `product_mode`. Will also expose `lead_score` (0-100) computed from job_title + company_size + use_case to auto-route.

karen-corp: Webinar narrative — propose 3-part agenda: 1) real-world benchmarks, 2) ops levers (batching, caching, quantization), 3) migration patterns + rollouts. Speakers: Emily (benchmarks), Ahmed (infra), Sara (product).

linda-content: Quick social drafts:
- "Benchmark: Serving LLMs at scale — hosted vs dedicated. Join our webinar: [link] :rocket:"
- "Keep latency low and costs down — live demo + Q&A: [link]"

sara-marketing: Can someone mock the conversion flow? Suggest: Register -> Confirm -> Attend -> Post-webinar -> offer trial + benchmark whitepaper. We should capture `product_mode` at registration.

mike-ux: Sketching funnel and confirmation modal now. I'll push frames to Figma by noon and add a variant that emphasizes privacy for Private mode.

rachel-sales: Hot lead rules: AE outreach window = 48hrs. Automation: if lead_score > 65 AND product_mode in (dedicated, private) -> sync to Salesforce campaign "Launch Web - Hot". Can ops add that tag?

tom-ops: Yes — can add `sf_campaign=launch_web_hot` and webhook to our SF connector. Will note retry/backoff for failures.

linda-content: Landing subheads (short):
- Hosted: "Fastest path to production-grade generation."
- Dedicated: "Committed GPUs, consistent throughput."
- Private: "Full control, enterprise compliance."

sara-marketing: Great. Let's do a 30-min copy polish tomorrow 09:30 PT. @mike-ux @linda-content @javier-growth @chris-analytics please confirm availability.

mike-ux: Confirmed.

javier-growth: Confirmed.

chris-analytics: In.

emily-prod: I'll bring the benchmark spreadsheet + sample graphs.

deploy-bot: Reminder: Calendar event created — "Launch Copy Sprint" — Tomorrow 09:30 PT. https://calendar.example.com/event/abc123 :calendar:

sara-marketing: Last ask — add one line in the footer about graceful degradation: "If capacity is constrained, requests may transparently fall back to compatible model variants to preserve availability." Keeps the promise clear.

tom-ops: I'll add that to the generic footer and to the FAQ snippet.

rachel-sales: Sweet. Thanks everyone — good momentum. :thumbsup:
